name: ambire-wallet
description: Ambire hardware signer — netlist (tscircuit) for the KiCad board

scripts.export:kicad: ./node_modules/.bin/bun ./node_modules/@tscircuit/cli/dist/cli/main.js export index.circuit.tsx -f kicad_zip -o dist/preview/kicad.zip && rm -rf dist/preview/kicad && mkdir -p dist/preview/kicad && unzip -o dist/preview/kicad.zip -d dist/preview/kicad && npm run kicad:prepare
